trials.claim: Includes all future Basic or Pro Plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Basic (Tier 1) or Pro (Tier 2-3) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence to confirm or contradict future Basic or Pro Plan updates.

trials.claim: Previous customers grandfathered into new features and limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about grandfathering previous AppSumo customers.

trials.claim: Can generate a 30-day channel-specific content campaign from a single topic in brand voice
trials.claimQuote: Luckily, Vocable AI can generate a 30-day, channel-specific content campaign from a single topic—all in your voice.
trials.reasoning: Although reviewers describe 30-day campaigns, one buyer could not generate any content due to platform errors and another found the customized brand voice was not applied across the tools, materially undercutting generation in your voice.

exhibits.quote: The biggest issue right now is that I cannot generate any content due to a "Network error" coming from the platform itself.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports being unable to generate any content at all due to platform errors.

exhibits.quote: I also spent a lot of time customizing and fine-tuning the brand voice feature, only to realise it wasn’t even being applied across the other tools within the platform.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the brand voice feature was not applied across tools, undermining the in-your-voice claim.

exhibits.quote: From there, you can create a 30-day campaign around a topic or business goal and organize the posts in a calendar or Kanban view.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms the product can create a 30-day campaign around a topic.

exhibits.quote: You can generate up to 30 days of content in one click, saving hours every month.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms one-click generation of up to 30 days of content.

trials.claim: Can scan website to extract brand profile including tone, messaging, positioning and audience
trials.claimQuote: Scan your website to instantly extract your brand profile—tone, messaging, positioning, audience, and content strategy
trials.reasoning: Buyers report URL scan problems and an 'unable to fetch data' error when creating a brand, materially limiting the claimed instant website scan despite one review describing the feature.

exhibits.quote: Support was also fast and professional to help me with a URL scan issue that I had when setting up my brand.
exhibits.argument: The buyer needed support for a URL scan failure when setting up the brand profile.

exhibits.quote: Error message "unable to fetch data" when creating a brand
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports a fetch-data error when creating a brand from a website.

exhibits.quote: It can scan your website and existing social content, analyze your writing patterns, and use your brand guidelines to develop a profile that informs the content it generates.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms website scanning to develop a brand profile for content generation.

trials.claim: Can scrape social channels to learn posting, engagement and performance across platforms
trials.claimQuote: Scrape your social channels to learn what you post, how you engage, what performs, and how your brand shows up across every platform
trials.reasoning: A reviewer confirms the product can scan existing social content and analyze writing patterns to build a profile that informs generated content, with no prosecution exhibit undercutting it.

exhibits.quote: It can scan your website and existing social content, analyze your writing patterns, and use your brand guidelines to develop a profile that informs the content it generates.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms scanning of existing social content to inform content generation.

trials.claim: Allows upgrading between license tiers while deal is available
trials.claimQuote: Ability to upgrade between 3 license tiers while the deal is available
trials.reasoning: Two reviewers confirm they upgraded from Tier 1 to Tier 2 and to Tier 3; the prosecution exhibit questions what changed after upgrading, not whether upgrading was allowed.

exhibits.quote: Where can I find the other features from Tier 2? After upgrading from Tier 1, nothing has changed at all.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports upgrading tiers produced no change, undermining the upgrade benefit.

exhibits.quote: I first bought Tier 1 and did a few tests. Then I upgraded to Tier 2.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms they were able to upgrade from Tier 1 to Tier 2.

exhibits.quote: I quickly upgraded from Tier 1 > Tier 3.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms they were able to upgrade from Tier 1 to Tier 3.
